title: Finishing With the Weak Hand Only
description: Players finish every single layup with the non-dominant hand for an entire set, forcing genuine improvement in the hand most players avoid.

content.objective: Build real confidence finishing with the weak hand by removing the option to switch back.
content.setup: Players approach the rim from the side matching their weak hand.
instructions: Approach the basket from the side where the weak-hand finish is natural.
Finish every single rep with the weak hand only, no exceptions.
Use a soft touch off the backboard rather than forcing the shot.
After ten makes, add one defender applying token pressure.
coachingPoints: Slow the approach down if needed — control matters more than speed here.
Keep the ball high and away from the body on the approach.
Celebrate the makes; this is meant to build confidence, not frustration.
commonMistakes: Switching back to the strong hand out of habit under any pressure.
Rushing the approach before the weak hand is ready.
Rushing the last two steps instead of gathering under control.
content.safety: Keep the area under the rim clear for a controlled, unhurried approach.
